theorems.name: Submission.lpf_c1r_whitney_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl n → ℝ) (τ : Eucl n → (Eucl n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn f A → ContinuousOn τ A → (∀ L : Set (Eucl n), IsCompact L → L ⊆ A → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖f y - f x - τ x (y - x)‖ ≤ δ * ‖y - x‖) → ∃ h : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, h a = f a ∧ HasFDerivAt h (τ a) a
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
